entities.name: Header compression configuration
entities.description: Information element used to negotiate or re-negotiate header compression configuration associated with an EPS bearer context.

entities.name: UE wishes to re-negotiate header compression with CIoT EPS optimization support
entities.description: Condition where UE wishes to re-negotiate header compression configuration and both UE and network support Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression.

entities.name: Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode with CIoT EPS optimization
entities.description: Condition for negotiating header compression after inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode when both UE and network support control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression, with UE in single-registration mode and interworking without N26 interface not supported.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression support
entities.description: Property indicating both UE and network support Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression.

entities.name: Single-registration mode operation
entities.description: Property indicating UE is operating in single-registration mode.

entities.name: Interworking without N26 interface not supported
entities.description: Property where UE has received interworking without N26 interface indicator set to 'interworking without N26 interface not supported' from the network.

relations.description: Header compression configuration IE is included if condition A is met.
Header compression configuration IE is included if condition B is met.
Condition A requires both UE and network to support Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression.
Condition B requires both UE and network to support Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression.
Condition B requires UE to be operating in single-registration mode.
Condition B requires UE to have received interworking without N26 interface indicator set to 'interworking without N26 interface not supported'.
